title: Bursfelde Benedictine missal: a bounded 1498 book state

traditions.label: Bursfelde Benedictine observance
traditions.scope: The printed missal expressly assigned to the Bursfelde union and observance, without treating other Benedictine congregations as one recension.
traditions.coverage_note: One original title and Mass-opening leaf establish a scoped book witness. The mandate, house reception, wider text, and relation to earlier or later prints remain open.

sources.title: Missale ordinis sancti Benedicti, BSB 2 Inc.c.a. 3665 s
sources.inspection: Original BSB scan images 3 (title), 6 (Trithemius letter) and 19 (fol. 1r temporal Mass opening) visually inspected on 2026-10-20; the IIIF manifest identifies the 604-canvas object, shelfmark, printer and bracketed publication date.
sources.limitations: Only selected leaves were read. The dated colophon and full Mass Ordinary, Canon, calendar and rubrics were not inspected. The scan manifest carries a Public Domain Mark; no historical text or image is republished here.

sources.title: Bayerische Staatsbibliothek IIIF manifest for bsb00030079
sources.inspection: Manifest metadata read on 2026-10-20: title Missale Benedictinum Bursfeldense; Speyer, Peter Drach; bracketed 1498-07-30 date; call number 2 Inc.c.a. 3665 s; 604 canvases; prefatory letter dated 1497-08-05.
sources.limitations: The manifest's date is catalogue metadata. Its transcription of the colophon was not checked against that leaf.

sources.title: USUARIUM 220, Missale Romano-Bursfeldense
sources.inspection: Full book record and contents index read on 2026-10-20; identifies the 1498 Speyer Bursfelde copy and indexed temporal, Ordinary, Canon, sanctoral, common, votive and rubrical sections.
sources.limitations: The contents index is not page-level collation. It labels image 6 a decree, but the image is a prefatory letter. USUARIUM requests attribution for use of its dataset.

sources.title: USUARIUM 469, Missale Benedictinum
sources.inspection: Full book record read on 2026-10-20: distinct 1481 Bamberg Johannes Sensenschmidt printing, OSB (IT), BSB 2 L.impr.membr. 71, Weale-Bohatta 1680.
sources.limitations: Original 1481 leaves and any textual relation to the 1498 Bursfelde print were not inspected; the catalogue identity alone proves no ancestry. USUARIUM requests attribution for use of its dataset.

stages.label: 1498 Bursfelde observance missal
stages.date_label: 1498 Speyer printing; exact colophon date unverified
stages.scope: The inspected title and fol. 1r First Sunday of Advent Mass opening identify the printed temporal as according to the Bursfelde union and observance. The indexed whole-book contents are a finding aid, not a collated text.
stages.witness_label: Missale ordinis sancti Benedicti, Speyer, Peter Drach, 1498; BSB 2 Inc.c.a. 3665 s
stages.summary: The first temporal Mass opening names the Bursfelde union and observance and gives the First Sunday of Advent formulary. This identifies a local Benedictine book state, with no claim that the book revises the 1481 Benedictine printing.

evidence.locus: BSB image 3, title; image 19, fol. 1r, red temporal heading and First Advent opening
evidence.claim: Original leaves identify a Benedictine missal whose temporal is assigned to the Bursfelde union and observance.

evidence.locus: Title, Published, Date and Call number metadata
evidence.claim: The library identifies the Speyer Peter Drach printing as 1498 and its copy as 2 Inc.c.a. 3665 s.

evidence.locus: Book 220 metadata and contents list, pp. 3, 19, 307, 331, 349, 409, 456 and 566
evidence.claim: The index connects the inspected copy to a complete Missal with identifiable Mass components.

stages.limitations: The 1497 Trithemius leaf is a prefatory letter, not an inspected promulgation. The exact 1498 colophon leaf, general chapter authorization, full text, and differences from other Benedictine books are unexamined. The 1481 USUARIUM 469 printing is a distinct bibliographic witness, not an established predecessor.
stages.reception: The printed heading states intended Bursfelde use; actual celebration from this edition at any named house and uniform adoption throughout the union are not established.

gaps.missing: Bursfelde chapter or other competent authorization and dated evidence of use of this exact printing at named houses.
gaps.next_source: Inspect Bursfelde chapter records, ownership or use annotations, house inventories and accounts alongside the original prefatory leaves.
gaps.consequence: The stage is a scoped book attestation, not an act-history station or proof of union-wide adoption.

gaps.missing: Collated component differences among the 1481 Benedictine print, 1498 Bursfelde print and the catalogue-reported 1534 Bursfelde printing.
gaps.next_source: Inspect original 1481 and 1534 copies and compare the Canon, Mass Ordinary, selected temporal and sanctoral formularies, calendar and rubrics with BSB bsb00030079.
gaps.consequence: No revision, ancestry or successor transition is recorded from bibliography alone.
